color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied exactly as-is per spec. pageBackground #ffffff (luminance 255) qualifies for color_register=light.

type-system.twistDescription: B. Letter spacing injection (intensity 3): added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em to h1 and h3. Gives headings a botanical herbarium quality — measured, precise, spaced like a specimen label. Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans (display) + Inter (UI/text), both Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: A. Duration scaling slower (intensity 2): all numeric durations ×1.3. Button: 0.18s → 0.234s, fade: 0.27s → 0.351s, transform: 0.36s → 0.468s, accordion/overlay: 0.9s → 1.17s, pulse: 2.52s → 3.276s. Botanical pacing — transitions breathe rather than snap.

grid-system.twistDescription: B. Gap value scaling (intensity 3): columnGap and rowGap ×1.4. bp-810px: 96px → 134px, bp-1024px: 64px → 90px. More spacious editorial breathing room aligned with botanical-archive aesthetic.

spacing-system.twistDescription: A. Global scale factor (intensity 2): all numeric spacing ×1.2. Creates expansive, breathable spacing that matches enlarged grid gaps. Quality like thick watercolor paper — substantial, with presence.

interaction-states.twistDescription: E. Focus state enhancement (intensity 3): added outlineWidth: 2px to all link focus states for keyboard accessibility. Tim-brack's distinctive line-through hover personality preserved — links use text-decoration: line-through on hover.

nav-system.twistDescription: C. Nav typography size increase (intensity 3): fontSize 0.75rem → 0.875rem (+0.125rem). Luxury mega-menu architecture preserved. 0.08em letter spacing gives precise spatial cadence. Centered logo position maintained.

concept-summary.twistDescription: C. Material shift: added one specific physical materiality paragraph to the Spatial System section — describing the global spacing scale as 'thick watercolor paper, substantial, with tooth.' Connects the abstract token values to sensory experience. Overall analysis preserved.
